Reference / logging/logger

logging/logger#

A logger for an application (#181): text lines to standard error, info and above, unless told otherwise.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let log = Logger("shop");
log.info("started");
log.debug("query", JsonField("ms", 9));   // below info: one check, nothing built
log.error("payment failed", failure);     // with the error that caused it

Description#

A logger for an application (#181): text lines to standard error, info and above, unless told otherwise.

Another destination or level:

Logger(name: "shop", destination: JsonStreamLogs(Stdout()), level: LogLevel.debug)

NamedLogging stays for a clock, fixed fields or a process of one's own.

Public API#

object Logger#

object Logger does Logging

A logger: a name, a destination and a level.

Logger.Logger#

Logger(name is string, destination is LogWriting = TextStreamLogs(Stderr()), level is LogLevel = LogLevel.info)

A logger called name, writing to destination at level and above.

Logger.debug#

debug(message is string, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at debug with fields; nothing is built below the level.

Logger.info#

info(message is string, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at info with fields.

Logger.warning#

warning(message is string, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at warning with fields.

Logger.warning#

warning(message is string, cause is Error, fields is ...JsonField) is void

With the error that caused it: log.warning("retrying", failure).

Logger.error#

error(message is string, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at error with fields.

Logger.error#

error(message is string, cause is Error, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at error with the error that caused it.

Logger.critical#

critical(message is string, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logs message at critical with fields.

Logger.critical#

critical(message is string, cause is Error, fields is ...JsonField) is void

Logger.log#

log(level is LogLevel, message is string) is void

Logs message at level.

Logger.log#

log(level is LogLevel, message is string, fields is LogFields) is void

Logs message at level with fields.

Logger.log#

log(level is LogLevel, message is string, fields is LogFields, cause is Error) is void

Logs message at level with fields and the error that caused it.

Logger.enabled#

enabled(level is LogLevel) is bool

Would a record of this level be written? Ask it before building costly fields: if log.enabled(LogLevel.debug) { ... }.

Logger.child#

child(segment is string) is Logger

The logger of a part, to the same destination at the same level: Logger("shop").child("db") is "shop.db".

name() is LogName

Its name.
